facts.fact: A senior officer of the Uganda Police Force's ICT directorate writes that the force resolved in October 2022 to embark on the Electronic Policing Information System project, and the head of the legal department of its Criminal Investigations Directorate writes that the Inspector General and all heads of directorates have endorsed the project, which seeks to automate case management processes across the force.

The bulletin's two police articles describe ePIS throughout as a project that 'seeks to' automate case management across the force and 'will' share data with prosecutors, courts and prisons; neither says it is in use at any station, and the editorial lists lack of internet connectivity at upcountry police stations among the obstacles; dated by the bulletin's imprint, May 2024.

The bulletin names no budget line or funder for ePIS; the police ICT officer writes only that continued investment in technology is crucial to electronic policing; dated by the bulletin's imprint, May 2024.
